name: NaviBeat Mixes
author: Nenad Jokic
description: Listening-aware playlists: time-of-day mixes, Rediscover, and Wrapped recaps.

scheduler.reason: Required to refresh your mixes on a daily schedule.

subsonicapi.reason: Required to read your library and create the playlists.

users.reason: Required to build mixes per user. Every Subsonic call needs a user to act as.

kvstore.reason: Required to remember when you listen to what, which is what makes the mixes personal. Stays on your server.
